pages.title: The fuel cycle
pages.text: Reactors run on $(thing)Uranium$(). Feed ingots through an Access Port set to Inlet and they fill the fuel rods.$(br2)As the reaction runs, uranium is consumed and $(thing)Cyanite$() builds up as waste. Pull the cyanite back out through an Access Port set to Outlet.

pages.title: Reprocessing
pages.text: Cyanite is not a dead end. A $(l:machines/cyanite_reprocessor)Cyanite Reprocessor$() turns it into $(thing)Blutonium$(), which is both a crafting material and a denser fuel than uranium.$(br2)That closes the loop: uranium in, cyanite out, blutonium back in.

pages.title: Fuel rod internals
pages.text: Each fuel rod block holds a slice of the reactor's total fuel tank. The tank is shared across the whole multiblock, so a rod at the bottom is no different from one at the top.$(br2)The terminal shows fuel and waste as a single bar. When waste crowds out fuel the reaction slows down, so keep an outlet running.
